Hi, we're building a platform called CrewLink that connects event organizers with freelance event staff — photographers, videographers, DJs, makeup artists, and catering teams. Think of it as an Uber for event staff.

Budget: around ₹12 lakhs for the MVP.
Timeline: 3 months to launch.

We're starting in India and UAE.

Core features needed:
- User profiles with portfolio uploads for freelancers
- Gig posting and application system for event organizers
- Payment processing (need Stripe and Razorpay)
- Review and rating system for both sides
- Real-time chat between organizers and freelancers
- Earnings tracking and payout management for freelancers
- Worker search and discovery with filters (location, skills, rating)
- Interview scheduling and instant booking
- KYC verification for freelancers
- Admin dashboard for platform management
- AI-powered recommendations to match the right freelancer to each event
- Push notifications and email alerts

We also need a website and mobile apps (iOS + Android). Looking for a full-turnkey solution. We have some investor interest and want to show a working demo in 3 months.

What would be the best approach — should we build everything at once or phase it?
